label: prose:intro-gravity-spacetime-lqg-comparison
html: Loop quantum gravity (LQG), the ADM canonical decomposition, and Ashtekar's connection-variable formulation are the three established programmes nearest to the QOU construction on the spacetime side. This section compares the QOU substrate against those programmes. The comparison identifies where each carries non-trivial categorical structure, where the QOU substrate supplies a structural extension, and where the assumptions diverge.
